column1: # Every shop in the Leaf. keeper and staff are roles bound to residents from map markers (names are tokens);
# their days come from VF routines (the keeper works open to close; staff from opens+1h). closed is a weekday
# (VF's week: Moonday Bellday Hearthday Wellday Lanternday Hayday "Market Day") or "-"; event shops open only
# while their calendar event runs. standing is the community whose standing title sets the discount
# (economy.json "discounts"). haggle: no, yes (one try per item per visit) or pawn (haggle what it pays you).
# interior blocks may name a variant after @ (shop_noren@ramen_noren: the Konoha session's variant ids).
# markup multiplies base prices (event stalls charge more). interior lists the blocks asked of the Konoha session.
